steps_to_first_alert: create a route with source alertmanager and copy its intake token
not_tested: Voice calls and SMS: IncidentRelay ships a stub voice provider, and you plug in your own. Delivery was tested with a generic webhook channel pointed at a local sink.
findings: the documented create-admin command exits 1 with: insecure IncidentRelay secret configuration, because exec does not get the runtime config the entrypoint generates. It works with -e INCIDENTRELAY_CONFIG_FILE=/var/lib/incidentrelay/incidentrelay.conf
